pages.title: Equip a Spellbook
pages.text: Equip a native spellbook to gain its spell capacity and normal equipment bonuses. Empty inscriptions still provide capacity.$(br2)Use Mastery's Spells screen to assign spells. Carrying an equipment-only book in your inventory is not enough.

pages.title: Your Prepared Limit
pages.text: All assignments in your hotbar sets share your capacity, including the same spell assigned to several positions. Shared quick-cast mode has its own saved arrangement.$(br2)Books and purchased upgrades can add slots. Replace or clear an existing assignment when all slots are occupied.
